notes.title: Purchase Privilege DLC Update
notes.notes:
Level 1: The visibility gets worse when the weather is foggy, so we set the weather to stay the same.
Level 2: Same as Level 1.
Level 3: The visibility gets worse when the weather is foggy, so we set it so it doesn't get foggy.

notes.title: Update Purchase Privilege DLC

notes.title: This game has been updated to version 1.40.
notes.notes:
This game has been updated to version 1.40.
Added "Level 17 Ambush" and "STEAM Achievement".
You need a graphics board on your computer to play level 17.
You can play the previous version by right-clicking the game name from the STEAM application and clicking "Properties" "Beta".
